business_summary.text: CarTrade Tech runs online platforms for new and used vehicles (CarWale, BikeWale), phygital and online auction services, inspection and valuation services, and the OLX India classifieds business across 12 categories.

call_points.text: EBITDA margin is shown rising from 9% in FY23 to 31% in FY26.
Deck claims 45%+ EBITDA growth in each of 16 consecutive quarters.
Used-auto platforms list 3.4 Mn+ cars a year and reach 23 Mn+ car buyers a year.
Used-car retail is run through partners: CarTrade owns brand, pricing and technology; partners run stores and inventory.
A strategic partnership with Landmark India for pre-owned mobility was signed in Mumbai in September 2026.
OLX India is building escrow payments and logistics tracking into its buy-now flow.
VAYA Live is pitched as an always-on market intelligence and targeting platform for OEMs and dealers.
Margins across all businesses will expand in FY27, with costs stable.
OLX grew 16% in Q4; management expects growth to strengthen as Elite Buyer and Verification scale.
New products were under 5% of revenue last year but should become significant this year.
Remarketing has about 130 auction sites, a physical network management calls impossible to recreate.
Cash reserves are ₹1,244 Cr; FY26 added about ₹300 Cr of cash.
ROE is about 10% because of the cash; returning cash is two to three years away due to tax shelters.
Management sees AI as an opportunity, citing 95% organic traffic and proprietary data; analysts asked about ChatGPT and Gemini risk.
Consumer business revenue split is about 70% OEM and 30% dealer.
Remarketing auction listings were about 1.7 million and volumes about 3 lakh.

timeline.summary: On May 7, 2026, CarTrade's Q4FY26 earnings call reported FY26 PAT of ₹243 Cr (up 68%), Q4 PAT of ₹70.84 Cr (up 54%) and cash of ₹1,244 Cr, with a four-to-five-year goal of about ₹1,000 Cr profit.

On 24 September 2026 CarTrade filed an investor presentation restating FY23-FY26 revenue CAGR of 22%, EBITDA CAGR of 66%, FY26 PAT of ₹244 Cr, zero debt and a Landmark India used-car partnership signing.
